input.quote: 13.1 Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: The subscription Services licence in 13.1 sits in walk-away territory: it is revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors, with no path to add them, and "Customer" is defined as Meridian Fieldworks alone (p0001), so Affiliates are not otherwise covered. It also fails the fallback, which requires Affiliate coverage (at minimum on written notice). 13.2 already gives a perpetual, irrevocable paid-up licence to Customer and its Affiliates with contractor support, and 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24.1 M&A assignment right, so the preferred position is reached by a single surgical fix to 13.1: extend the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and replace discretionary revocation with the uncured-material-breach standard already used in 13.3 (this also removes the "non-transferable" conflict with 13.3).

proposal.summary: Extend the Services licence in 13.1 to Affiliates and contractors and limit revocation to uncured material breach.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that the licence must reach our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and may not be revocable at Vendor's discretion, so we have conformed 13.1 to the revocation standard already in 13.3. If helpful, we can instead add Affiliates on written notice as a fallback.
